meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按该技能流程创作 HyperFrames 动画关键帧:识别动画主体与状态、选择最小实现机制、编写可定位的动画,并用 `hyperframes` 命令验证画面。它会遵循运行时规则,不使用计时器、随机数等不可靠来源。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要可定位的 2D/3D 关键帧、GSAP 时间线、CSS 动画等效果,或需要 `hyperframes keyframes` 诊断时触发。不用于整体场景策略等。

say.text: 把这段 SVG 路径描边动画改成用 DrawSVGPlugin 实现。
say.note: Claude 会替换实现机制并验证。

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude follows the skill to author and verify HyperFrames keyframe animations: identify the animated subject and states, pick the smallest mechanism, write seek-safe keyframes, and prove them with `hyperframes` commands. It obeys runtime rules, avoiding timers, random numbers, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS animations, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Not for broad scene strategy.

say_en.text: Use hyperframes keyframes to check whether this CSS keyframe is seek-safe.
say_en.note: Runs the diagnostic command to verify seek-safety.

say_en.text: Switch this SVG stroke-draw animation to use DrawSVGPlugin.
say_en.note: Claude swaps the implementation mechanism and verifies.
